summary: The diff successfully implements both requirements. REQ-1 is addressed by removing automatic page refresh on error and adding permanent error state tracking in AdminSetupNotice.tsx. REQ-2 is addressed by the backend migration.mo module that resets stale adminAssigned flags when no real admin exists. All acceptance criteria are covered with appropriate error handling, manual retry options, and backend state correction logic.
